name: Tuan Colascar
bio: After the conquest, petitions for Hilir can go through Colascar. Before the settlement his rank in the port is not known.
notes: fact: Birch calls him Javanese and names him in the post-conquest settlement; Pires likewise assigns him Hilir (Birch III, pp. 166–167; Pires II, pp. 281–282)
gameplay: His petitions are invented and do not imply he held pre-conquest office or maintained a personal feud with Upeh (people-factions.md §§2–4)
